faqs.question: Do you manufacture custom springs in Plovdiv?
faqs.answer: Yes. We manufacture custom metal springs in Plovdiv, Bulgaria based on drawings, samples or technical specifications.

faqs.question: What types of springs do you produce?
faqs.answer: We produce compression springs, extension springs, torsion springs, wire forms and custom spring parts.

faqs.question: Can you manufacture springs for industrial machines?
faqs.answer: Yes. We manufacture springs for machinery, industrial equipment, repairs, agriculture, automotive and other technical applications.

faqs.question: What information do you need for a quote?
faqs.answer: Send the spring type, dimensions, wire diameter, material, quantity, drawing or sample, and application details.

faqs.question: Do you supply companies outside Plovdiv?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can supply companies across Bulgaria and Europe.

focus.title: A technical partner for custom parts
focus.body: When a standard spring or spare part does not solve the problem, Stevini helps turn a drawing, sample, or worn component into repeatable production. We take a practical approach: function, working environment, critical dimensions, and material are clarified before we propose a manufacturing route. The result is not just a wire product, but a part that fits the machine, line, or repair.

request.title: What to send for a quote
items: Send a drawing, photo, sample, or short description of the problem and mounting position.
Include the available dimensions, material, quantity, load, working environment, and critical contact points.
We check feasibility and clarify details where needed before preparing a realistic quote for a small or medium batch.

capabilities: B2B production for machines, lines, maintenance and industrial batches
Precision turned parts up to Ø16 mm

geoFacts: A suitable partner for engineers, maintenance teams and procurement when a part has to fit a specific machine, line or mounting point.
Production of springs, wire forms, conveyor belts and precision turned parts with a focus on function, not a universal catalogue.
Useful for replacing worn spare parts, small batches for new products, and adjustments to existing assemblies.
The process is direct: technical clarification, feasibility confirmation, production and dimensional checks before delivery.
